# Introduction

The **`singlearm`** analysis (Single Arm Survival) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Performs survival analysis for a single cohort without group comparisons. Kaplan-Meier estimates use event times and risk sets; in competing-risk mode, cumulative incidence retains competing terminal events as separate states. Optional person-time rates use the sum of individual observation periods as their denominator. This is descriptive analysis of one cohort, not a treatment-effect estimate.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("singlearm_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::singlearm(
#   data = singlearm_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `singlearm` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
